content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD subgrid-porosity module, entire file guarded by '# if defined (SUBGRID)' (L51, closed L448). MODULE SUBGRID_MODULE (L52) stores per-cell subgrid bathymetry DepSubGrid(Mloc,Nloc,ratio,ratio) and derived Porosity/DepAvgSubgrid/DepMaxSubgrid/MaskSubgrid arrays. SUBGRID_INITIAL (L76-191): reads SubMainGridRatio (L89; if absent only prints 'use 1 for default' L93 without assigning), OUT_POROSITY via keyword 'Porosity' (L102), NumPixel=SubMainGridRatio**2 (L104); allocates arrays (L106-109); re-reads DEPTH_FILE (L113, GetFile parallel L129 or unit 1 serial L131-137) and ghost-fills via PHI_COLL (L141-146, comment L140 notes duplication with init.F); loads subgrid bathymetry via GetFile_Subgrid (L148); then for every cell counts wet pixels (DepSubGrid>0) to get DepMaxSubgrid=max pixel depth (L167), DepAvgSubgrid=sum(wet depths)/NumPixel (L171), Porosity=wet count/NumPixel (L172), with fully-dry cells DepAvgSubgrid=-LARGE (L169); dry cells (Porosity<SMALL) get Porosity=1 for etauv_solver (comment L177, L180); optionally writes porosity.ini via PutFile (L184-188). UPDATE_SUBGRID (L193-228): same pixel counting but only where MaskSubgrid==1 (L197) using instantaneous total water depth tmpv1=Eta(I,J)+DepSubGrid(I,J,II,JJ) (L203) to update DepAvgSubgrid/Porosity (L210-215), then again Porosity<SMALL -> 1 (L223). GetFile_SubGrid (FILE,PHI,MaskS): PARALLEL version (L231-302) reads on all ranks sparse rows 'Ix Iy value(1..ratio**2)' from unit 1 until EOF (L255-265, label 100), fills PHIGLOB(Ix,Iy,II,JJ)=tmp_read((JJ-1)*SubMainGridRatio+II) (L260-261) and mask MaskS_glob_R(Ix,Iy)=1 (L257), scatters each pixel plane through GLOB_to_LOC (L268-274) plus mask (L276-277), and backfills PHI=Depth(I,J) where MaskS<1 (L279-289); serial version (L305-341) prefills PHI with Depth (L317-325), reads the same sparse format storing at ghost-offset indices MaskS(Ix+Nghost,Iy+Nghost)=1 (L330) and PHI(Ix+Nghost,Iy+Nghost,II,JJ) (L333-334). GLOB_to_LOC (PARALLEL only, L346-444, ykchoi 08/May/2017): rank 0 copies VarGlob into ghost-padded PHIGLOB with edge-copy ghost fill (L365-388), gathers each rank's ghost-extended index ranges via 4x MPI_Gather (L398-405), keeps its own block PHI=PHIGLOB(1:Mloc,1:Nloc) (L408), and sends each other rank its slab xx=PHIGLOB(istanum:iendnum,jstanum:jendnum) via mpi_isend/mpi_irecv+mpi_wait (L411-438).

verbatim_spans.text: !  TIDE_MODULE is a module to add tide/surge boundary conditions into wave simulation
! distribute depth to ghost cells, this part will be repeated in init.F
! if porosity = zero,meaning dry point, just set 1 in etauv_solver

unresolved: Header comment @L46 describes 'TIDE_MODULE ... tide/surge boundary conditions' - copied from the tide module, does not describe this SUBGRID module

SubMainGridRatio @L89-100: when absent from input.txt the log claims 'use 1 for default' (L93) but no assignment SubMainGridRatio=1 exists, leaving it undefined before NumPixel= @L104 and ALLOCATE @L109

Cross-line index inconsistency between GetFile_SubGrid branches: serial stores at ghost-offset (Ix+Nghost,Iy+Nghost) @L330,L333 while parallel stores at (Ix,Iy) into global arrays @L257,L260 that are later mapped through GLOB_to_LOC which applies the Nghost shift @L368 - net alignment differs if Ix,Iy are 1-based interior indices
UPDATE_SUBGRID updates DepAvgSubgrid/Porosity but never DepMaxSubgrid; initial pass uses still-water DepSubGrid>0 (L160) while update uses Eta+DepSubGrid>0 (L203-204)
GLOB_to_LOC rank 0 self-block PHI=PHIGLOB(1:Mloc,1:Nloc) @L408 assumes rank 0 subdomain starts at global origin (Nistas(1)=1)

rMASKS allocated @L106-108 but never used; unused declarations: AvgEta,TmpEta,tmpv3,tmpv4 @L60, Ktmp,tmpk1,tmpk2,pcount1,pcount2 @L61, LINE @L69, l @L235/L308, Ifile @L83, TMP_NAME only used for porosity.ini @L186
OUT_POROSITY is read with input keyword 'Porosity' @L102 (name differs from variable), and READ_STRING for DEPTH_FILE @L113 duplicates the read done in init.F (comment @L140 acknowledges repetition)
Dry-point convention: Porosity set to 1.0 where <SMALL (L180, L223), so fully-dry cells carry porosity 1 downstream by design for etauv_solver
Commented debug block @L291-297 (tmp0.txt); PHIGLOB in GLOB_to_LOC @L351 is a fixed-size automatic array defined on all ranks but only filled on myid 0 @L365-388
